sloka: ततः शोकेन महता शैलराजसुतां नृपः ।प्रणिपत्य ह्युमां देवीं सर्वेणैवान्तरात्मना ।। ७.८७.२१ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ śokena mahatā śailarājasutāṁ nṛpaḥ ।praṇipatya hyumāṁ devīṁ sarveṇaivāntarātmanā ।। 7.87.21 ॥

translations.english: Then, overwhelmed by great sorrow, the king bowed down to the goddess Uma, the daughter of the king of mountains, with his entire heart and soul.
